title: Destroy Sequential Targets
sourceKind: search-snippets-only (official page returns 403 to WebFetch; statement taken from search-result summaries of secondary sites)
summary: Given nums and space, a seed target destroys every target differing from it by a multiple of space. Return the smallest seed that destroys the most targets.
officialConstraints: Not confirmed from the official page.
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps nums at 50 values from 1 to 1000 and space from 1 to 1000. The example comes from a search summary (nums [3,7,8,1,1,5], space 2, answer 1); not confirmed on the official page.
